agent-automations.descriptionHTML:
Returns automations whose created_by user is the authenticated caller, across repositories the caller can read. This includes both user-owned and repository-owned automations created by the caller but excludes repository-owned automations created by someone else even if the caller has write access to the repository.

Use the repository-scoped list operation for those automations. The owner_type filter only narrows this creator-scoped collection.

Fine-grained access tokens for "List automations for user"

This endpoint works with the following fine-grained token types:

  • GitHub App user access tokens
  • Fine-grained personal access tokens

The fine-grained token must have one of the following permission sets for each repository accessed by this request:

  • "Agent tasks" repository permissions (read)
  • "Contents" repository permissions (read)

The required permission set depends on each repository's Automation permission configuration.

GitHub App installation access tokens are not supported for this endpoint.

agent-automations.descriptionHTML:
Creates a new automation in a repository. User-owned automations remain private to their creator. Repository-owned automations are visible to anyone with read access to the repository and manageable by anyone with write access to the repository.

Fine-grained access tokens for "Create an automation for a repository"

This endpoint works with the following fine-grained token types:

  • GitHub App user access tokens
  • Fine-grained personal access tokens

The fine-grained token must have one of the following permission sets for each repository accessed by this request:

  • "Agent tasks" repository permissions (read and write)
  • "Contents" repository permissions (read and write)

The required permission set depends on each repository's Automation permission configuration.

GitHub App installation access tokens are not supported for this endpoint.

agent-automations.descriptionHTML:
Edits specified fields on an existing automation in a repository. Omitted fields are left unchanged. The automation's owner_type is immutable and cannot be changed by this operation.

Fine-grained access tokens for "Edit an automation for a repository"

This endpoint works with the following fine-grained token types:

  • GitHub App user access tokens
  • Fine-grained personal access tokens

The fine-grained token must have one of the following permission sets for each repository accessed by this request:

  • "Agent tasks" repository permissions (read and write)
  • "Contents" repository permissions (read and write)

The required permission set depends on each repository's Automation permission configuration.

GitHub App installation access tokens are not supported for this endpoint.
